(b) In hospital, technicians wear protective gloves to handle liquid radioactive materials, such as those
containing Bi-213. To monitor radiation exposure, they wear a specialised ring on their finger, as shown in
Figure 12.2(a). Each ring contains a small chip in a plastic enclosure (Figure 12.2(b)), which detects and
records radiation doses. The rings are collected every three months to monitor the radiation exposure of the
technicians.
